title: History
brief: History rail panel: sent requests grouped by day with method, status and time; selecting one shows the recorded request read-only and its response, with Resend, the deleted-source state and the empty state. Built on the bolt-v2 shell.

artboards.title: Sidebar list, read-only document tab
artboards.tradeoff: Familiar and reuses the request document; a read-only tab next to editable ones relies on the banner to tell them apart

artboards.title: History as a document table with detail pane
artboards.tradeoff: Most data per row (URL, duration, status filters), best for scanning many sends; gives up the sidebar tree and squeezes the recorded response into a side pane

artboards.title: Sends grouped by request, replayed in place
artboards.tradeoff: Keeps history next to the request it came from and shows what changed since; deleted sources need a separate read-only fallback, so there are two ways to view a record
